title.zh: World launches self-custodial ‘super app’ World Money
title.en: World launches self-custodial ‘super app’ World Money

current_state.zh: World launched World Money, a self-custodial 'super app' rolling out in over 150 countries that combines stablecoin payments, digital asset rewards, trading, Mini Apps, and Stripe-powered funding.
